pages.text: Wild packs roam: zerg in caves, protoss by a lone pylon, terrans at a campfire. They wake when a player comes near. Rare ruined terran outposts, zerg nests and xel'naga temples hide underground.
The races claim land: a wild base sends parties to take caves and fields and dress them its way. Now and then they land a squad by your home; the game rule starmineAiPressure sets how often.

Beyond the first three bases near your spawn, $(l)far bases$() of the races lie all over the world: one in about every other region of 1536 by 1536 blocks, never within 1000 blocks of the spawn — a terran base over a technological labyrinth, a protoss base over ancient temples or a zerg lair with its tunnels. They are built when you come within 128 blocks; their sky ships and heroes are only over the first three.$(br2)No monster spawns within 30 blocks of any unit or building of any race.

Traders of the other races: a $(l)protoss preserver$() keeps one xel'naga temple in two (no guards then) and sells protoss gear, void shards and the Xel'Naga relic for minerals and vespene; $(l)Dehaka$() lives in his cave of flesh and bones and sells zerg gear — and takes essence: rotten flesh, spider eyes, bones, ender pearls for minerals.
The races are always foes and keep apart: a pack, a claim or a nydus worm of one race never appears within 96 blocks of another race's wild.
